decisions.decision: The committee deferred liaison assignments until the July 28 meeting so members have more time to consider which liaison assignments they would like to take on.
decisions.quote: the committee deferred liaison assignments until the july 28t meeting to give members more time to consider which liaison assignments they would like to take on.

decisions.decision: The debt service policy revision will include a separate policy on excluded debt, distinct from the policy on regular debt, with separate, clearly stated limits that are easy to measure and apply.
decisions.quote: the revision to the debt policy will include a policy on excluded debt as well as, but separate from, the policy on regular debt:

decisions.decision: John will revise his spreadsheet to show historical and projected debt service costs from regular borrowing and debt exclusion overrides through FY21, excluding CIP projects under $300,000.
decisions.quote: john will revise the spreadsheet he is working on to show historical and projected debt service costs from regular borrowing, debt exclusion overrides through fy21

decisions.decision: John will make the two corrections to the June 9, 2016 minutes and submit the corrected minutes at the next meeting.

budget_items.topic: Town Manager's report on FY16 results
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Projected FY16 expenditures are under budget and revenues over budget, which would produce more free cash to help fund the capital budget; no dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: b. projected fy16 expenditures are under budget and revenues are over budget.

budget_items.topic: Use of projected surplus for sick leave buyback
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town could use some of the projected surplus to buy back unused employee sick leave; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the town could also use some of the projected surplus to buy back some unused sick leave

budget_items.topic: Debt policy threshold for excluded CIP projects
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The debt service exercise would exclude all Capital Improvement Projects under the stated threshold.
budget_items.quote: exclude all capital improvement projects under $300,000 in the capital improvement plan.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Committee report says revenues are nearly level with FY2015 and the reserve balance is about the stated amount.
budget_items.quote: revenues are nearly level with fy2015 and the reserve balance is about $320,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Minutes report that change order #15 was approved for the stated amount, covering capping, radiator covers, elevator operator costs during the Verizon strike, and excavation/drainage at the maintenance garage.
budget_items.quote: the committee approved change order #15 for $24,732.

budget_items.topic: Total school project change orders to date
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Change order #15 brings total change order costs to date to the stated figure, which is within the contingency in the budget.
budget_items.quote: change order #15 brings total costs of all change orders to date to $1,058,736.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total change orders are described as well within the approximately $4,000,000 contingency in the budget.
budget_items.quote: this is well within the approximately $4,000,000 amount for contingency in the budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Little risk of cost overruns is reported, given the nature of the work and the contingency built into each project.
budget_items.quote: there is little risk of cost overruns due to the nature of the work and the 20% contingency built into each project
